courseOutcomes.description: Understand domain-specific applications and apply the principles of IoT, including physical and logical design and  deployment templates
Use the principles of IoT and M2M, their differences, and key concepts like SDN, NFV, and essential management protocols.
Develop and apply IoT design methodology, utilize Python for logical system design, and leverage key Python packages through practical case studies.
Experiment using Raspberry Pi with Python to control LEDs and switches, interface with other IoT devices.
